intended_object: A leaf of a machine-generated proof tree (`PTree`) for row 099 of the genus-four census. It holds the witness `w6`, and its docstring says its entry inequalities sit at position 6 in `proof.subs`. I inferred this from the docstring, the name and the auto-generated module path.
explanation: This is part of a generated certificate used by the library's computer-checked proof for genus-4 Brill–Noether graphs. It is one leaf of a proof tree that holds a precomputed witness. It does not formalize any standard mathematical object. It is an internal device of the proof, so there is no notion in the literature to compare it with.
